scope: Problems observed while making the public GThink page functional.

incidents.symptom: The UI reported that the blob stream was ready while GThink was still awaited as listener.
incidents.cause: The public page had a transport but no reliably attached GThink responder at startup.

incidents.symptom: GThink could produce a local gateway.response while api.ask() remained waiting.
incidents.cause: Local emitBlob() dispatched the response but pending requests were only resolved on inbound channel traffic.

incidents.symptom: A working responder could still appear disconnected when the response depended on a channel round trip.
incidents.cause: The local flow unnecessarily depended on cross-channel propagation for completion.

incidents.symptom: An older responder/person script could remain loaded even after a code correction.
incidents.cause: Static GitHub Pages assets can be cached while the page URL remains unchanged.

incidents.symptom: The visible status could say GThink was awaited while runtime state had changed, or vice versa.
incidents.cause: UI state and bus state are asynchronous and previously lacked an independent auditor.

incidents.symptom: A committed fix was not necessarily the version already served by GitHub Pages.
incidents.cause: Pages deployment and Control Tower follow-up commits can lag or supersede an earlier run.
guard: never claim live PASS from commit alone

required: local response resolves pending without channel dependency
BroadcastChannel v1 loopback PASS or explicit legacy waiver
loaded script versions match expected versions
no regression of person local memory
mergeGate.policy: Do not merge incident-branch changes into main until the checks above have factual evidence.
